I am a Mathematics graduate with practical Business Intelligence
experience at PKF Attest. I work mainly with Power BI and SQL,
with Python and R for analysis. I also hold a separate bachelor's
degree in Primary Education.

I am looking for a junior Data Analyst or BI Analyst role in an
international, English-speaking team, particularly in Switzerland.
I am based in Madrid, available immediately and willing to relocate.

[Explore my projects](projects.qmd) ·
[Get in touch](mailto:lauraiglesiasgarcia23@outlook.es)

## Business Intelligence experience

### PKF Attest · Spain

**Business Intelligence Intern · September 2024–January 2025 · 676 hours**

I worked on live projects for Weleda, Inncome and FAES Farma
as the only intern in an eight-person BI team. The firm extended
my internship, which concluded when I began the mandatory,
fixed-schedule teaching placement for my concurrent degree
in Primary Education.

**Commercial reporting for Weleda**

I developed a Power BI sales dashboard, from discussions
with the client about requirements to billing and customer
analysis pages.

Using DAX, I calculated gross and net billing, year-to-date
totals, year-on-year changes, customer activity and top-10
customer concentration. Users could explore performance
by product, channel, region and salesperson.

I also calculated quartile-based RFM customer segments,
using colours and icons to distinguish key, loyal, at-risk
and inactive customers. With support, I configured security
roles to restrict access to company data.

**Data quality and reconciliation for Inncome**

I investigated billing discrepancies across MySQL and Navision
sources. In Power Query, I combined and cleaned the data,
identified duplicate records and removed them after approval
from my supervisor.

The resulting totals matched estimates provided by the client,
who confirmed their consistency during a review meeting.

**Data modelling and user communication**

I queried and joined SQL tables to understand their relationships,
then modelled one-to-many relationships between billing and
date, customer, product and salesperson tables in Power BI.

My work also included SQL Server stored procedures, query
optimisation, SSIS, Azure Data Factory and multidimensional
models. I presented dashboards, explained calculations and
supported business users.

This experience taught me to connect technical work with
business questions: understand the source, validate the
calculation and explain what the result can support.
